subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: When Antigravity automatic mode has one exhausted quota lane and another usable lane, should menu-bar and highest-usage presentation surface the exhausted lane, preserve a usable lane, or use context-specific selection semantics?
rationale: Current main deliberately filters exhausted windows, while this branch changes that established behavior differently across reset-focused display and highest-usage ranking; tests cannot determine the intended user-facing contract.

options.title: Use Context-Specific Semantics
options.body: Allow reset-oriented presentation to surface an exhausted lane, while highest-usage ranking and text consistently use the maximum binding usage lane and exclude Antigravity only when every family is blocked.

options.title: Always Surface Exhaustion
options.body: Select the most constrained or exhausted lane in every automatic display and ranking context, even when another Antigravity family remains usable.

options.title: Preserve Usable Lanes
options.body: Keep current-main compatibility by filtering exhausted lanes whenever another supported Antigravity lane remains usable.

recommendation.title: Use Context-Specific Semantics
recommendation.body: Allow reset-oriented presentation to surface an exhausted lane, while highest-usage ranking and text consistently use the maximum binding usage lane and exclude Antigravity only when every family is blocked.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and merger of the relevant quota and model-family features, steipete is the strongest available owner for this user-facing contract.
